content.what_it_is: MATLAB workspace script that clears state, selects output index 24 and reads bathymetry (L1-L7), loads eta/mask/depth-averaged velocity and four vertical-profile coefficient grids for each selected index (L12-L23), constructs ten still-water-referenced z planes from 0 to -dep (L30-L32), computes za from dep and eta (L34), and reconstructs three-dimensional U and V using the documented quadratic vertical formulas (L25-L39).
entities: eta, mask, u, v, Ax, Ay, Bx, By at L16-L23
l loop index and z at L30-L31

equations.ref: quadratic u vertical reconstruction documented at L26
quadratic v vertical reconstruction documented at L27

unresolved: Cross-iteration overwrite: files is explicitly a vector and drives the loop at L4 and L12, but z, U, and V are indexed only by vertical level at L31 and L37-L38, with no k/output dimension or per-file save. If files contains more than one index, every iteration overwrites the preceding reconstruction and only the last remains.
Mask interface is ineffective: mask is loaded at L17 but never referenced after assignment, so dry/invalid cells are not masked before za, U, and V are computed at L34 and L37-L38.

All loaded grids at L6 and L16-L23 are assumed dimensionally compatible; n and m measured at L7 are never used for checks, so incompatible inputs fail later by MATLAB array operations rather than an explicit interface check.
The z-level formula at L31 divides by z_num-1, while z_num is user-editable at L9 and has no guard against 1.
The hard-coded absolute fdir at L2 has no override or existence check.
